context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 108 verified new Smart Orders feature. Backend endpoints: POST /api/smart-orders (create), GET /api/smart-orders (list), DELETE /api/smart-orders/{order_id} (cancel). Modes: paper (executes against paper trading), live (owner-only, broker execution), simulate (preview without execution). Features: ladder entries (2-10 levels, equal/weighted_bottom/weighted_top distribution), trailing SL/TP, break-even protection, multi-take-profit (up to 5 levels). Frontend: Smart Orders accessible via user menu dropdown (data-testid='nav-smart-orders-btn'). Panel has Create/Orders tabs. Form elements: smart-order-symbol, smart-order-qty, smart-order-side-buy/sell, smart-order-sl-toggle, smart-order-sl-price, smart-order-tp-{n}-price, smart-order-ladder-toggle, smart-order-be-toggle, smart-order-simulate (Preview), smart-order-submit (Place Buy/Sell). APScheduler monitors smart orders every 30s.
